Act I

The story so far

Since 2023 Dance Vaganza has put Dance Central students on stage, with trophies, bouquets and a full audience.

2023Season 1

The first Dance Vaganza: student performances, trophies for young performers and bouquets for the guests who presented them.

2024Season 2

Talent from every age group, true to the show's promise of a stage for every age. The show also announced an initiative for children with special needs, followed by dedicated dance workshops.

A vibrant celebration of community, creativity and compassion.
2025Season 3 · Broadway Musical

The stage became a Broadway musical, with interconnected dance stories, lively dialogue and dynamic choreography building to one grand finale.

Photos from Dance Vaganza 2023 and 2024.

What every performer takes away

Creativity and expression

Dancers learn to tell a story through movement and to show emotion on stage.

Teamwork and collaboration

Rehearsals and group performances build discipline and the habit of working together.

Performance skills

Stage presence and new performance techniques, with the joy of dancing in a theatre setting.

Act III

Take the stage

Registering takes a few minutes. Fill in one form per dancer and the studio will send you the payment link.

  1. 1

    One form for each participant. A parent or guardian enters the details.

AED 450per participantlast season's fee, to confirm

The registration fee covered last season

  • Costume
  • Make-up and hair
  • Food for the participant
  • A participation certificate
  • Two tickets to the show

The fee is non-refundable, non-transferable and cannot be set against regular class fees.

Before you register

  • Attendance at all rehearsals is mandatory, and extra rehearsals may be added.
  • The studio makes the final decisions on choreography, costumes and casting.
  • No flash photography or videography during the performance.
  • Event photos and videos may be used on Dance Central's social media.

Full rules and regulations are shown on the form before you submit.
